description: Use-after-free in tlsProcessPendingData; remote unauthenticated attacker may execute commands with Redis server privileges.
scope: Bounded isolated compatibility tests only. Passing functional tests do not approve vulnerable Redis for hardware installation, product use or redistribution.
eosImpact: EOS requires TLS; disabling TLS is not an accepted mitigation. Loopback bind narrows reachability but does not remediate the vulnerability.
